Title: Lamine Yamal has reached 10 goals and 10 assists
Text: No other player in Europe's top five leagues has been the first to hit double figures in both categories during the current campaign. At just 18, Yamal continues to redefine expectations with his all-round attacking output.

Title: The Siege in Paris
Text: Barcelona endured relentless pressure in the first half, facing ten shots on target from PSG before the break. It is the most shots on target Barça have conceded in a Champions League first half since records from the 2003/04 season.

Title: Among the most prolific attacking runs ever recorded
Text: Barcelona's attack has reached historic levels in 2026. The Blaugrana have scored at least four goals in five of their eight Champions League matches this year, a 62.5% strike rate that matches the highest ever recorded in a calendar year by a team playing five or more European Cup games, alongside PSG in 2017.

Title: 🔴🔵 BRAVE. CONFIDENT. TOGETHER.
Text: Hansi Flick on whether PSG is an early final or a major test: “It will be a good test for us to see where we stand. I want my team to play with confidence, bravery and togetherness, just as we’ve done in recent matches.” “We’re facing arguably the best team in the world over the last two years. It’s a great opportunity to show our level and see what we can improve. After the match, we’ll know a lot more.”
